what_this_commits: The pilot real-sampler defect-injection artifacts for EXP-HQC-982268 (TASK-20260806-77a574): design.md (pre-registered injection choice, expected-effect direction, and mechanical-soundness criteria, written before any data was generated), pilot_injection.py (a thin wrapper injecting the V3 last-block-early defect via a module-attribute monkey-patch, calling stage_a.py's real, unmodified decode_blocks internally, sha256-pinned), pilot_results.json, pilot_report.md, run_manifest.yaml, and run logs.
ordering: Committed and verified BEFORE either independent review task (TASK-20260806-8d4d48 validator, TASK-20260806-92aecb red-team) is dispatched.
status_of_contents: OBSERVATIONS ONLY, per the executor's role. FIRST BATCH IN THIS CAMPAIGN TO INJECT A DEFECT INTO THE REAL (T)-SAMPLER PATH rather than a planted-content proxy. Defect class: V3 (last-block-window-read-early), applied only to block index n_e-1, the narrowest of four candidate injection points and the Red Team's explicit recommendation from the prior batch's review, chosen for stringency rather than ease of detection. Mechanical soundness: SOUND against every pre-registered criterion -- no crashes, the injection invariant held on every trial (0 violations), both deliberate-mismatch fail-closed dry runs aborted correctly, and the wrapper's identity check confirmed it genuinely calls the real unmodified decode_blocks. Measured signal: a clean null on the load-bearing paired defected-minus-undefected comparison at k=m=17 (diff = -0.207, combined jackknife SE = 0.444, z = -0.466; max |z| = 0.700 across k = 2..26) -- though each arm individually deviates from the theoretical null of 0 (consistent with prior PS-R3 batches already showing the undefected estimator is non-zero at finite T), which is why the paired difference, not either arm alone, is the number that isolates the injection's effect. Throughput: defected 2,097.6 t/cs, undefected 2,105.6 t/cs (a negligible ~0.4% difference, within timing noise), both roughly 3% below the cost model's optimistic band (2,168-2,227 t/cs) and about 2.66-2.67x the pessimistic figure (788 t/cs) -- closer to optimistic by a wide margin, corroborating the Validator's prior judgement of which figure to trust. Budget: 5.34 of 400 authorized core-seconds used (1.3 percent). No interpretation of what this implies for OPEN-6 or the campaign's stopping-rule decision is offered here -- that is reserved for the Validator and Red Team.
claim_boundary: Toy. A single defect class at a single injection point, 2,000-10,000 (T)-distributed trials at PS-R3's reduced parameters, one seed family, no replication. This is a pilot instrument check, not a measurement of HQC: no statement about A17, HQC's decoding-failure rate, or any standardized parameter set. Whether this pilot's clean result licenses scaling to the full run, or whether the campaign's stopping rule instead points toward a PAUSE review, is not decided by this snapshot and is the explicit deliverable of both pending reviews and the Coordinator's subsequent decision.
